summary: Diversified Funding wants a first-property setup controlled by Accounting, with property and leasing staff largely limited to viewing information. The clearest configuration decisions are a current-rent-first payment priority, commercial buildings and suites, monthly rentable garage spaces, and an automatic key fee. Major implementation work remains outside settings: an exact custom gross-potential report, Massachusetts deposit-interest checks and tax reporting, commercial lease/CAM workflows, utility monitoring, accounts-payable approvals, payment reconciliation, work orders, historical conversion, and support/training.

callsUsed.title: Entrata | Diversified Funding, Inc.
callsUsed.brief: Brock from Entrata, along with Cheryl from Diversified Funding, Inc., discussed Diversified Funding's need for a new property management system to replace their outdated Genarc software. Cheryl highlighted critical requirements including robust accounting for commercial properties, an online payment portal, and an efficient work order system, while also expressing concerns about AppFolio's inability to handle LMR interest and 1099 forms. The conversation concluded with a plan to schedule a tailored demo of Entrata's capabilities, focusing on addressing Diversified Funding's specific needs and ensuring a smooth implementation process.

callsUsed.brief: Tijah, Brock and Vincent from Entrata, along with Cheryl from Diversified Funding, Inc., discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its accounting, reporting, and CRM capabilities. Key highlights included Entrata's ability to automate tasks, generate custom reports like the critical Gross Potential Rent report, and simplify the 1099 and security deposit interest processes. The conversation also touched on Entrata's integrated system, robust support, and flexible implementation approach, with future meetings scheduled to delve deeper into accounting and commercial property management.

callsUsed.title: DFI | Entrata (Accounting Demo)
callsUsed.brief: Brock, Tijah, Nick and Jon from Entrata, along with Cheryl from Diversified Funding, Inc., discussed Entrata's accounting and payment processing capabilities, focusing on Cheryl's specific reporting needs and the potential for Entrata to streamline Diversified Funding's accounts payable and reconciliation processes. A key point of contention was Cheryl's demand for a specific report format, which Entrata is exploring multiple solutions to meet, including a business intelligence tool. The conversation also covered vendor management, invoice approvals, payment processing, bank reconciliation, journal entries, and budgeting, with Entrata highlighting features designed to automate and simplify these tasks.
